other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual cattle farmer (not a group, firm, or organization).
Eligible cows must be indigenous breeds such as Gir, Sahiwal, Haryana, Gangatiri, or Tharparkar.
Benefit can be claimed for a maximum of two cows per farmer.
Incentive can be received only once in the lifetime of each cow.
Application must be submitted within 45 days of the cow's calving.
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹10,000‑₹15,000 per cow for high productivity and improved breeds.
